There's nothing left to do: all 25 tests pass when I re-run `python3 -m unittest` (`Ran 25 tests ... OK`).

One correction to my earlier summary: it said "8 bugs," but it only lists 7 fixes. The listed fixes are the ones I can account for. The "8" was most likely a miscount. Since this isn't a git repo, I can't use a diff to check whether any other change was made. Either way, the suite passes now.
